login.tagline: Sign in with your Telegram account
login.staleAttempt: That sign-in attempt is no longer valid. Request a new code.

setup.title: Setup
setup.tagline: First run — paste your Telegram app credentials to finish setup.
setup.openTelegram: Create an app at my.telegram.org/apps — it takes two minutes.
setup.phonesHint: One per line, or comma-separated. Only these numbers will be able to sign in.
setup.credentialsHint: Written to config.toml on this machine, and sent nowhere else.
setup.restart: Start ii-drive again, then sign in.
setup.alreadyConfigured: This server is already configured — nothing to set up here.

channels.title: Channels
channels.tagline: Choose where your files are stored
channels.hint: Pick one or more channels. Uploads are spread across them.
channels.noneFound: No channels found — add this account to a channel first.
channels.wireWarn: Saved, but some bots could not join:

telegram.storageHint: Uploaded files are stored as documents inside your storage channels.
telegram.botsHint: Bots download through their own rate limits, so several spread the load. Adding a bot invites it into every selected storage channel as an admin.
telegram.draftOpen: a bot setup is still open with @BotFather
telegram.newBotNote: walks @BotFather, or paste any token below
telegram.noBots: No bots configured — downloads use your own account.

botfather.title: Create a bot with @BotFather
botfather.resumed: Picked up where you left off — this conversation is still open with @BotFather.

stage.name: BotFather is waiting for the bot’s display name.
stage.username: BotFather is waiting for a username ending in “bot”.
stage.token: BotFather issued the token — add it to the pool.

botfather.cancelHint: Tell @BotFather to drop the half-finished bot

settings.reloadConfigHint: Rereads config.toml — paths and credentials still need a server restart

instance.title: Instance settings
instance.hint: Server-wide upload behaviour, shared by every account. Stored in the database and applied immediately — no restart, no config.toml edit.
instance.thumbs: Generate thumbnails (in-process for images, ffmpeg for videos)
instance.strategyStream: Stream — relay straight to Telegram, no disk use
instance.strategySpill: Spill — buffer to disk first, faster on fast links

other.languageHint: Interface language. Translations are downloaded from the server only when you pick one.
other.devModeHint: Exposes internal tooling — including a direct view of the embedded database. Only enable this if you know what you are doing.
other.internalDbReserved: Browsing the embedded database is reserved for the server operator. This account cannot open it.

upload.splitHint: Files larger than this threshold are cut into parts of that size and uploaded in parallel — each part on a different bot's connection when you have a pool, so big files finish much faster. 0 disables splitting.
upload.currentThreshold: Current threshold: {size} — parts upload in parallel, so more bots means faster large uploads.
upload.routingHint: Files uploaded to the root folder are sorted automatically: the first rule whose type prefix matches claims the file. Explicit folder picks in the drive always win over rules.
upload.noRules: No rules — uploads to the root stay in the root.
upload.createFolderFirst: Create a folder in the drive first.

db.title: Internal DB
db.reserved: The internal database browser is reserved for the server operator. This account cannot open it.

files.publicTitle: Public — anyone with the link can download
files.empty: No files found — upload something to get started.
files.name: Name
files.deleteBody: Delete “{name}” ({size})? This removes it from Telegram storage as well — there is no undo.
files.deleteBulkBody: Delete {n} file(s)? This removes them from Telegram storage as well — there is no undo.

drive.dropZone: Files — drop here to upload into the current folder
drive.deleteFolderBody: Delete “{name}”? The folder must be empty — files and subfolders inside it are kept and must be removed first.
